description: GET a URL, decode the HTML, and return plain text with block-level structure preserved as newlines. Scripts, styles, and comments stripped; HTML entities decoded. Lighter than markdown when you only need the reading content.

allow_private_hosts.description: Allow loopback / private / link-local targets for this call (default false). Refused unless the server operator launched fetch-mcp with FETCH_MCP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS=1 -- SSRF protection stays on by default either way.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in ms for the request, covering DNS, every redirect hop and the body (default 10000)

name: fetch_html_to_text
